answer: Every entry must show Valued herb seller hall warrant before the ledger opens, because a warrant sellers carry after stall trials. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. Trying costs 95 separate visits, each one billed £55 at the door a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. The hollow is checked, not assumed. The ocean is on the docket. One glacier, one entry.
